summary: Preserve AbortSignal cancellation of Node promise-based timers, including AbortError rejection and interval iteration failure.

target.notes: Integrate with the Node-compatible timer scheduler and existing JsPromise/async-iteration semantics.

semantics.abort: aborting prevents the pending timer completion from succeeding
semantics.setTimeout_setImmediate: returned Promise rejects with an AbortError
semantics.setInterval: pending/future async-iterator operation terminates by throwing/rejecting AbortError
semantics.reason: host AbortSignal cancellation is observable Promise/iterator failure

caveats: Do not map abort to silent cancellation or a successfully fulfilled default value.
Preserve Node AbortError identity/name/code according to the selected host profile.

tests.name: timeout abort rejects
tests.expected_behavior: prints AbortError ABORT_ERR on current Node profiles

tests.name: interval abort terminates iteration
tests.input: const {setInterval}=require('node:timers/promises');const ac=new AbortController();(async()=>{try{let n=0;for await(const x of setInterval(1,'x',{signal:ac.signal})){if(++n===2)ac.abort()}}catch(e){console.log(e.name)}})();
tests.expected_behavior: after two yields the iterator terminates by throwing AbortError
